Heat in Bangkok

Bangkok

A tropical megacity where heat costs lives, livelihoods and a share of the economy.

What heat does here

Nearly 80%

of informal workers surveyed cut their hours in the heat.

What is in place

304 cool rooms

For the 2026 hot season, Bangkok opened 304 cooling centres in schools, health centres and district offices.

What helps

Cooling centres work best close to home, and open when people need them.

Sources: Government of Thailand, 2026; World Bank, Shaping a Cooler Bangkok, 2025; WIEGO.
